items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Gerald came over and performed Lunceford tunes with Jon Faddis’s Carnegie Hall band.

ctx.x: Huh? Yeah, the actress and dancer. We became like families. I had my wife come out to California for the first time, and we stayed at Gerald and Etta’s. I had a band to meet her at the airport. That was fun. So I’ve know Gerald for quite a long time. As a matter of fact, just very recently, we had an occasion to play the Berne festival in Berne, Switzerland. Gerald came over and performed Lunceford tunes with Jon Faddis’s Carnegie Hall band.
